description: BCH BLS12-381 Groth16 Fiat-Shamir PIT with fused coordinator/quotient head and bounded prefix cache. Compute a fixed-width OR mask of the two canonical public scalars for zero-window record lengths only. Saves341 total bytes; authenticated digits, statement, roots, transcript and all46 raw argument pushes remain unchanged. Finite ten-fixture source/native evidence.
deployment: one9-input current-BCH transaction for supplied fixtures
method: fused coordinator/quotient head with authenticated code pages and bounded data-only prefix cache, paired nonnegative eval6 Horner reductions, final-total relation projection, fused nonnegative accumulation, retained lazy pair product, cached Regular main16/id15, compact zero-window transcript, two-chart quotient-torus, authenticated public-VK contribution, residue verdict, q132 split, Regular arithmetic initializer, fused First0/AdditionTail1 with reused parser/PIC helper, canonical public-scalar OR mask for zero-window length detection
sourceRevisionRole: Qualified normal source owner with default-off RPA_PIC_ZERO_MASK=1, RPA_FUSE_COORDINATOR_HEAD=1 and RPA_CACHE_COORDINATOR_PREFIX=1. Only zero-window detection uses the fixed32-byte OR of canonical public scalars. Authenticated PIC digits, all46 raw archived argument instructions and all21 logical stages remain exact. The root pins final ordered eight-worker lockings inline before loading complete coordinator code from the existing four funding carriers and FirstTail literal overflow. No expected worker hash is imported; no hash fixed point. Prefix data functions and shared arithmetic unchanged. Disabling the mask reproduces the previous normal nine-input primary report exactly.
scoreScope: Primary aggregate is scripts plus transaction overhead; maximum supplied-fixture score is separate. Native prices are reported separately from Libauth.

resourceCertification.status: Ten finite complete-graph source/native fixtures; no universal arbitrary-witness bound or live relay claim.
resourceCertification.invalidScope: All173 current same-profile invalid transactions and350 direct prior-origin records retained with all nested histories and8 locking relocations. All176 current source cases and10currentcarrier controls included. Complete transaction byte-identity dedup only; every origin retained. Historical targets retain their old layouts.
